rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"TypeCollector no longer indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] when building member diagnostics. A property's key-null diagnostic now gets its location from a new GetPropertyIdentifierLocation helper, and a field's MemberNeedsKey diagnostic uses FirstOrDefault(). Both return null for symbols that come from metadata. The analyzer's report callback is also wrapped so that diagnostics whose location is not a source tree of the current compilation are dropped. New tests compile a generic struct or record struct into a metadata-only assembly, use a closed instance of it as a member, and check that the build has no diagnostics and that the resolver is generated.","why":"MP-2283: a closed generic value type from a referenced assembly has members that exist only in metadata. Indexing their empty DeclaringSyntaxReferences threw IndexOutOfRangeException in both the generator and the analyzer, and the assembly ended up without its generated resolver. Reporting a diagnostic at a location outside the compilation is also not allowed for analyzers.
